stages.name: Play the story
steps: Play all 5 chapters as Jason and Lucia. There are no mission gold medals to chase, so just enjoy the campaign.

Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before the chapter ends — the only possibly missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude). After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her out to the balcony and accept.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter. There is no mission replay, so your saves are the only safety net.
Take optional missions as they show up (purple icons, and black icons with pink letters) — they open up robberies, fishing, hunting and more.
Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study new animals through your binoculars as you go: the 100% list needs 200 of 277 base vehicles and 100 of 255 animals.
stages.trophies: 12 story trophies + the one missable warning

stages.name: The 100% completion checklist
steps: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Everything you did during the story already counts toward it.
Clear every robbery: all gang operations, bank jobs, payday loan jobs, bank vaults and underwater discoveries. These are the only tasks that need everything.
Finish the collectibles the checklist asks for in part: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos.
Work the activities: 300 stunts, all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, all 42 drone time trials, 30 of 40 unique races won, 15 of 15 Bret target decks.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges — you can skip the 10 hardest. PowerPyx notes the checklist is closer to 60% true completion, so do not hunt everything.
stages.trophies: A Long Road (gold) + most activities, collectibles and crime trophies

stages.name: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
steps: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands across Leonida (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count).
Finish the character questlines: Andy (Lucia-only), Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (Jason-only).
Mop up the remaining meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude and any combat, driving or miscellaneous trophies left over.
Check your trophy list one last time — Vice Got a Price! pops as soon as the 54th other trophy does.
